meta.why_two_checks: A whole-file blob match alone cannot distinguish 'unchanged' from 'an array deleted together with the assertions that consumed it' -- both leave the remaining bytes identical to some other prior state's remaining bytes, so the per-array name+entry-count inventory is what makes a deletion visible.
meta.how_to_update: If this file legitimately changes, re-derive this inventory from the file with an independent parse (never hand-edit the numbers) AND state in the commit message which array changed and why -- never edit this JSON merely to make a surprise disappear.
